name: Harem Mansion
source:
Step into Hiroshi's shoes, a curious college student whose life takes an unexpected turn when he inherits the enigmatic Western Takana Mansion. Nestled near the prestigious Mono Academy, this mansion is not just any old estate—it's a gateway to otherworldly secrets and forbidden desires.

[From [url=https://thenaughtythree.itch.io/harem-mansion]Itch.io[/url]]
